GenAiFunction.description: Returns an Account 360 snapshot rendered as the Account 360 Snapshot HXL widget. Business Accounts: ARR, health, renewal, open pipeline, key contacts, top opportunities. Person Accounts: insight tiles, grouped details and the customer's devices (Assets); business fields are intentionally empty there. Accepts EITHER an Account name (e.g. "Northwind Traders") OR a 15/18-char Account Id in accountRef; it resolves names to records on its own, so pass whatever the user said and do not ask the user for an Id first.
